title: Join us for the June 25th, 2026 Knowledge Portal Network Webinar!
bodyHtml:
Hear from Emily Griffin, from the Gaulton Lab at UCSD, who will present on T1GRS: A Machine Learning Model for Determining T1D Risk and Heterogeneity

? June 25th, 2026

⏰ 12-1 PM ET

Top 3 questions T1GRS can answer:

  1. How is an individual’s T1D risk shaped by the full landscape of T1D-associated variants?
  2. How do interactions between risk variants improve identification of at-risk individuals?
  3. How can we use genetic risk profiles to identify disease heterogeneity with real differences in clinical outcomes?

Register for the webinar
summary: Learn about T1GRS: A Machine Learning Model for Determining T1D Risk and Heterogeneity
